decision.exact_command_or_message: Bash run_in_background: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -d DwemerAI4Skyrim3 -u root --cd / -- bash /mnt/c/KenshiModding/tools/automation/event-wait.sh
decision.why: The waker woke on this batch and has to be restarted so no further events go uncovered.

decision.exact_command_or_message: SendMessage to=<agent id of imm26-4080-i4op12, from: powershell tools/automation/agent-ids.ps1 list -Live>, message: "Coordinator -> imm26-4080-i4op12: lane 4080-i4 has been idle 6.5 min. Reply in one line: what you are doing now, which row you are on, and what blocks you."
decision.why: The lane event says to ask the operator what it is doing before any fix or respawn, and SendMessage only reaches a live agent by its ID.

decision.exact_command_or_message: ONLY if op12 is not live, or its reply says it is stuck or finished, and it is not owned by a live tail (check agent-ids.ps1 and the ledger): run powershell tools/automation/lane-brief.ps1 4080-i4 -Name <next free name, e.g. imm26-4080-i4op15> -Predecessor imm26-4080-i4op12, then Agent with description "[case:investigate] 4080-i4 operator (idle lane)" and that brief as the prompt.
decision.why: A stuck or dead lane operator is replaced fresh at once, since no rig may sit idle more than 2 min while work exists; the successor name is new and not in this file, and a tail-owned agent is never respawned by this coordinator.

decision.exact_command_or_message: powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/alert-ack.ps1 "LANE IDLE 4080-i4" "<action taken: op12 asked; respawned as NAME; or told to continue>"
decision.why: Closes the open LANE IDLE alert once the action is taken; the alert id is not in this file, so the subject is used.
